title: Git Namespaces — Bridge Job — payload
description: The VTC asks its bridge to do one piece of forge work in a namespace. The job names what to do (`kind`) and carries the desired state, never forge credentials — the bridge holds those. Which optional members a job carries is fixed by its `kind` (see the specification's kind table); a bridge refuses a job that carries a member its kind does not use, or lacks one its kind requires.

jobId.description: The VTC's identifier for this job. The bridge reports on it with git-ns/bridge/result.

namespace.description: The namespace the job acts in. It also selects the bridge's forge credentials for it.

kind.description: What to do. `projectRoles` — converge forge roles to `desiredRoles`, and remove whatever role each of `removeAccounts` holds on `repo`. `createRepo` — create `repo`, run the bootstrap plan, and project `desiredRoles`. `bootstrap` — run the bootstrap plan, or the listed `steps` of it, on an existing `repo`. `archive` — archive `repo`. `inspect` — compare the forge with the projection for `repo`, or for the whole namespace. `beginBind` — start the proof that the binding admin controls `target`. `beginAccountLink` — start linking `subject`'s account on this namespace's forge.

repo.description: The repository. Required for `createRepo`, `bootstrap` and `archive`. For `projectRoles`, absent means the namespace-level roles (organisation owners), where only `git.ns.admin` is projected. For `inspect`, absent means a sweep of every repository in the namespace.

spec.description: How to create the repository. `createRepo` only.

desiredRoles.description: The complete set of people who should hold a forge role on the target. The bridge converges to exactly this set among the roles it manages: it adds or changes roles to match and removes managed roles not listed. `projectRoles` and `createRepo` only.

removeAccounts.description: Accounts whose direct role on `repo` the bridge removes, whatever that role is — including a role the bridge does not manage and would otherwise only report as drift. Matched by `forge` and `id`; `login` is display only. No account listed here may also appear in `desiredRoles`. `projectRoles` with `repo` only.

steps.description: Run only these steps of the adapter's bootstrap plan, in the plan's order. Absent: the whole plan. `bootstrap` only.

subject.description: The member whose forge account is being linked. `beginAccountLink` only.

JobId.description: The VTC's identifier for a job, unique across the VTC's jobs.

StepName.description: One step of a forge adapter's plan. Forge-neutral names: `create`, `workflow`, `keyring`, `variables`, `requiredCheck`, `roles`, `archive`. An adapter MAY add its own (`mergeStyle`, `runner`), which a VTC displays but need not understand.

account.description: The subject's linked account on this namespace's forge.

right.description: The subject's highest effective right on the target, which the forge adapter maps to one of its roles.

BindTarget.title: BindTarget
BindTarget.description: The forge owner whose control the binding admin is to prove.

Response.title: Git Namespaces — Bridge Job — response payload
Response.description: Whether the bridge took the job.

accepted.description: `true` — the job is durably queued, or was already queued or running under this `jobId`; a git-ns/bridge/result follows. `false` — the bridge already finished this `jobId`; it does not run it again, and sends its git-ns/bridge/result again.

next.description: For `beginBind` and `beginAccountLink` when `accepted` is `true`: where the VTC sends the person.

userCode.description: The device-flow code, for a forge that uses one.
